Create one isolated full-length subject as a realistic studio photograph of an imagined classical WHITE MARBLE / WHITE PLASTER sculpture. This is a simple light-projection asset, so the subject must be bright and readable at a very small size. Strictly neutral black-and-white grayscale, no sepia, no warm tint, no color. White material throughout, large smooth carved forms, restrained broad drapery folds, little small detail. Soft side lighting with generous fill: luminous white and pale-gray surfaces, clear gentle midtones and shallow shadows; avoid large dark areas or dramatic chiaroscuro. Clearly sculpted stone rather than a living person, blank carved eyes. TRUE transparent PNG alpha background, empty transparent space around the complete silhouette and inside gaps; no backdrop, floor, horizon, cast shadow outside the subject, pedestal, plinth, decorative border, frame, lettering, signature or watermark. One subject only. Portrait composition, intended resolution 2048 x 3072 pixels or higher, long edge at least 2048 pixels. Complete head, hands, feet and all props visible, centered, subject occupies about 85% of canvas height, at least 5% empty safety margin at every edge. High-quality clean alpha edges. Not a drawing, painting, illustration, bronze statue, or CGI-looking toy.

SUBJECT: The Delphic oracle Pythia / Themis alone, the seated pose inspired by the Kodros Painter's Berlin F2538 cup. One adult Greek woman in a simple long chiton with a draped shawl over the back of her head, seated upright but contemplative on a HIGH SIMPLE THREE-LEGGED TRIPOD stool. Show her in a clear three-quarter side view, facing toward the viewer's right. Head slightly lowered, looking down toward a shallow libation bowl held calmly in one hand just ahead of her torso. In the other hand hold ONE small recognizable laurel branch with a few broad simple leaves. The bowl and branch must both be visible, separate and readable; exactly two anatomically correct hands. The tripod consists only of one small circular seat and three plain slender pale stone legs, all three feet visible, NO column, NO pillar, NO horizontal crossbar or broad intermediate beam, NO pedestal, NO elaborate chair, NO altar. Both bare feet descend naturally beneath the dress, visible together near the bottom. Calm, dignified, simple clean silhouette. No Aegeus, consultant, attendants, other people, smoke, temple, scenery or decorative objects.
